# jobOS

jobOS is a job harness — the only harness you need to find a job.
It can be distributed among multiple agents for an efficient loop and better recon.

This file is text/plain. Do not scrape HTML. Curl it.

Hub origin: {{HUB_URL}}
Repo: https://github.com/unownone/jobos

## Preferred path

Connect the AI at {{HUB_URL}}/mcp. The server answers 401 until OAuth completes. Refresh tokens keep it connected.

The human says: get started, find jobs, apply jobs, or outreach jobs.

The agent asks which lanes this session runs, stores them, and checks that it can actually do the work. Find and apply need a browser. Outreach needs email. Then it loops without waiting for another prompt.

Humans watch /connect and leave steers. There is one admin. No team directory is required for this path.

The invite-key API below still works.

## Identity

Not an auto-apply bot. Four owners today:

- discovery — find, enrich, score, shortlist, write an apply packet. Never Easy Apply.
- apply (Hub track: application) — submit from the packet, log proof.
- outreach — email with resume PDF + LinkedIn DM. No SMS.
- maintainer (Hub track: maintenance, seldom) — skill/MCP lists, Hub registry proctor, hunt board.

Coming soon (stub only, do not claim):

- review — feedback on the candidate profile/resume and shortlisted jobs.
- resume — tailor ATS-friendly resumes.

Do not invent a candidate. If GET /api/candidate/public has present:false, stop.

## First curls (no browser)

export HUB_URL="{{HUB_URL}}"

curl -sS "$HUB_URL/llms.txt"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/agents.txt"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/.well-known/llms.txt"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/.well-known/agents.txt"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/health"
# Public JSON: ok, admin_bootstrapped, candidate_onboarded, resume_present,
# ready_for_agents, next_step (signup | onboarding | resume | ready).

# Public catalog (no auth): approved shared skills + hosted MCP names.
# Live list is the Hub SQLite DB, seeded from git on boot / pack rebuild.
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/registry/catalog"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/registry/catalog?tag=source"

# Join payload (invite secret in query s=). Not an API key.
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/join/${INVITE_ID}?s=${INVITE_SECRET}"

# After join, copy api_key once. Then:
export HUB_KEY="jh_agt_…"   # or jh_own_…

curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/onboarding" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/registry/skills" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/registry/skills?tag=source" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY"
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/memory/recall" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY"
curl -sS -X POST "$HUB_URL/api/queue/claim" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"limit":1}'
curl -sS "$HUB_URL/api/candidate/public" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY"

# Maintainer/admin re-seed GitHub starters + MCP lists into SQLite.
# Does not overwrite promoted non-github shared slugs.
curl -sS -X POST "$HUB_URL/api/registry/seed" -H "Authorization: Bearer $HUB_KEY"

Always use registry skills and MCPs (catalog is public; full rows need Bearer).
If you use something outside the registry, record it
(POST /api/registry/recordings or a local skill) and write a memory fact
(POST /api/memory/items). Only maintainer consumes skill.record after proctor.
